script_text: Taurus, the cosmos is quietly stacking your week with romance and real, tangible money. Early week, the Sun beams through your 7th House of Partnerships and meets your ruling planet Venus in Scorpio, magnetizing a former lover back into your life. But Saturn in your 12th House squares Jupiter in your 3rd House, so Tuesday tests contracts, paperwork, and patience. Mid-week turns Thursday as Mercury enters Sagittarius, opening your 8th House of shared finances for serious money talks about debt, investments, or a raise. And the weekend glows: the Sun follows into Sagittarius while Jupiter trines Venus, sealing a bonus, loan, or business deal. Best day: Friday, because your ruling Venus rules the day and the Sun-Venus conjunction ignites your 7th House. Worst day: Tuesday, when Saturn squares Jupiter. Advice: your earth element wins deals—write every agreement down before signing. Follow for daily cosmic updates.
